review_evidence: README identifies the repository as an implementation and formal verification of Quicksort, proving termination, memory safety, permutation preservation, ordering and lawful customizable partition schemes.
All 23 current-primary Lean files are Quicksort library/partition/lemma modules or Example.lean; package configuration is lakefile.toml and therefore already non-primary metadata.
No current-primary path was shown to be a content-lossless runner/generated layer, so the formal algorithm, proof infrastructure and example remain retained.
summary: Retain the entire current-primary formalized Quicksort corpus, including the usage example and all partition correctness developments.
